significance: The largest lake in Himachal Pradesh and a Ramsar wetland since 2005, revered as the embodiment of the goddess Renuka, mother of Parashurama. A five-day fair each year around Prabodhini Ekadashi brings pilgrims from across northern India.
story: After the death of the sage Jamadagni, Renuka is said to have entered these waters and become the lake itself, promising her son Parashurama an annual reunion.
